room_description: A luxury master bedroom featuring a large bed, fireplace, mounted deer head, and several pieces of white ornate furniture.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the luxury bedroom.
Inspecting the pillows on the left side of the bed to find a gold coin.
Checking under the pillows on the right side of the bed.
Examining the mounted deer head with colored dots on its neck.
Opening the bottom drawer of the long white sideboard.
Retrieving a metal rod from the ice bucket containing a wine bottle.
Unlocking a small ornate chest inside a desk drawer to find a scroll.
Using a coin to reveal a hidden compartment behind a portrait.
Viewing a color-coded number clue on a piece of paper: 2694.
Entering a 4-digit code into a wall-mounted keypad.

solution_steps: Observe the color sequence on the deer head's neck (White, White, Yellow, White).
Use the metal rod to poke the fireplace screen in a specific spot to release a mechanism.
Correlate the numbers with the dot colors on the deer head or portraits.
Input the resulting sequence 9426 (based on room clues) into the keypad.

final_action: Using the blue keycard on the electronic lock next to the exit door.
